# Edit model script with specific info

```{r load, echo=FALSE}
model_sbat <- readLines("./scripts/public_genomes/extract_chromosome/extract_largest_contig_model.sbat")
species_names <- c("cfreundii","cportucalensis","ecoli","ehormaechei","eludwigii","kpneumoniae"  ,'sliquefaciens')

for(i in species_names){
  species_sbat <- model_sbat
  species_sbat <-  species_sbat %>% gsub("taxa_name",i,.)
  writeLines(species_sbat,paste0("./scripts/public_genomes/extract_chromosome/extract_largest_contig_",i,".sbat"))
}
```
